name: Bubble (vesicle)
oneLine: A hollow ball of double layer that traps water inside.
howItWorks: A flat sheet has exposed edges, so it curls up and seals itself into a ball. Feed it more fatty acids and it grows. Gentle shaking can split it in two.
deeper: Jack Szostak’s lab showed fatty-acid vesicles grow into long threads and split under gentle flow, with no machinery at all.
sizeComparison: up to a 20th the width of a hair
simplification: Growth and splitting are sped up hugely.
